tools.name: options-analytics_black-scholes-greeks

tools.name: options-analytics_implied-volatility-solve
tools.description: Solve implied volatility for 1 to 500 option prices with Newton and Brent root-finding on Black-Scholes-Merton, or on a Cox-Ross-Rubinstein tree for American options. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/options-analytics/implied-volatility-solve Keywords: when pricing or analysing an option, spo

tools.name: options-analytics_american-binomial-price
tools.description: Price an American or European option on a Cox-Ross-Rubinstein tree with optional discrete cash dividends (escrowed method), and return tree delta, gamma, theta, the early-exercise boundary and the Black-Scholes-Merton Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/options-analytics/american-binomial-price

tools.name: options-analytics_strategy-payoff
tools.description: Compute payoff and profit or loss of a multi-leg option and stock position at expiry and at a valuation date, with exact breakevens, maximum profit and loss, and unlimited-risk flags. tools.name: options-analytics_iv-rank-percentile
tools.description: Compute IV rank and IV percentile of the current implied volatility against caller-supplied history over a trailing window of observations. tools.name: options-analytics_volatility-surface-fit
tools.description: Fit a raw-SVI slice per expiry to strike implied volatilities with the Zeliade quasi-explicit method, interpolate the surface in total variance, and report butterfly and calendar static-arbitrage violations. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/options-analytics/volatility-surface-fit Keywords: w

tools.name: options-analytics_put-call-parity-check

tools.name: options-analytics_expected-move
tools.description: Compute the one and two standard deviation expected move and price ranges from implied volatility or from the at-the-money straddle price. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/options-analytics/expected-move Keywords: when pricing or analysing an option, spot, daysToExpiry, straddlePrice, dayBasi

tools.name: options-analytics_skew-metrics
